scenarios.title: Tools of the Trade for a Necromancer: Smith, Malus, Charsi (stage 2b of the staged drill)
scenarios.provenance: CHEATED: level 28 (a hero whose damage fits the cloister crowd; the sandbox hero is clvl 19 with real stat points, this setup has none), a Rogue mercenary, cap, quilted armor, short sword, buckler and a mesh belt (12 potion boxes: the live hero carries 5 to 6 healing in the belt) worn, 8000 gold, waypoints Cold Plains, Black Marsh and Outer Cloister, and potions by SETUP verbs. Town start, nothing written after the start. Mechanics only. Necromancer variant: wand, cap and quilted armor worn by SETUP.
scenarios.notes: The tapper taps Start on malus and Hand in. U: record 3 is Tools of the Trade (docs/progression/quests.md index list); the Malus is picked from the Smith's drop and consumed by the Charsi hand-in, so the end state is record 3 bit 0, not an item. The imbue item pick is imbue:best (no chooser, docs/actbot.md): if the hand-in stalls on the pick this is a finding, not a scenario fault. Whether the shipped Normal offline offers the imbue at all is U. town.bankFirst 0: with the default the bank chore moved 6900 of the 8000 gold into the stash in the first minute and the chunk then waited 28 minutes on chores it could not pay (run 20261120-184924-bb3e, finding in the probe doc). Belt is four healing potions: the kit gate asked for 'healing potions 3/4' with a 3+1 belt and the chunk sat on its chores step (run 20261120-192148-b1a8). Necromancer variant of act1.tools.malus: the Paladin gear (short sword, buckler, mesh belt) fails the equip seeding for a Necromancer (strength), so a wand and no shield/belt; summoner SME build. quests.layoutRead 1 as the sandbox (the Smith's spawn point is read from the level layout; run 20261123-051018 parked on `boss not found in the arena: needs quests.layoutRead 1` after a clean walk to the Barracks). Level 34 (was 28): the Barracks gate wants max life 300 (`not ready: max life 300 needed for the Barracks (have 235)`, run 20261123-164135-8aad) and the SME summoner table reaches about 235 life at clvl 28; 34 is a CHEATED stand-in at the gate, not a statement about when a played Necromancer reaches it. goals reach:50 because at clvl 34 the default reach:30 is already met and the bot idles in town (run 20261123-164716-d94a). Level 40: at clvl 34 the SME hero has 283 max life, still under the Barracks floor of 300 (taps log: `not startable ... max life 300 needed for the Barracks (have 283)`, run 20261123-164921-809c). A played summoner without gear life bonuses reaches 300 around clvl 36 to 38 (U: gear not modelled); the fixture is a stand-in at the gate.

assert.why: U docs/progression/quests.md: record 3 = Tools of the Trade, bit 0 = completed after Charsi
no death: these setups are far above the boss's level, a death is a RED (the format has no min 0 with a positive max)
chicken bound: at most 3 chickens (the one 'starting chunk' line is counted in the max)
the board started the tapped chunk (the hero engaged)

scenarios.title: Sisters to the Slaughter for a Necromancer (stage 3 of the staged drill; antidotes in the pack, the unattended hold off)
scenarios.provenance: CHEATED: level 26 (Normal Andariel is dangerous below about clvl 24), 15000 gold, the waypoints Cold Plains to Catacombs 2, a hired merc (hireling 0) and potions by SETUP verbs. Without the merc the board holds Andariel back as 'too hard' (run 20261120-221758-41b3: no merc, short of potions, would likely lose), which is the readiness model working as intended. Town start, nothing written after the start. Mechanics only, never a statement about the level a played hero fights her at.
scenarios.notes: MILESTONE (andariel1): the board holds Andariel as too hard for this hero (no skills spent, clvl 26 from a SETUP verb): the readiness model is right, the tapper logs the reason, and the hero must still walk the Monastery road to the Outer Cloister. The kill itself (record 6 bit 1) needs a geared hero and is U. The tapper taps Start on andariel (autoStart is never: a player decision). Kill sets record 6 to 0x2002 or similar with bit 1 = reward pending (V docs/d2d-probes.md: 0x200a after the kill; the Warriv talk sets bit 0). The assertion is the kill word (bit 1); the hand-in to Warriv belongs to act1_done.sail_east, not here. town.bankFirst 0: with the default the bank chore moved 6900 of the 8000 gold into the stash in the first minute and the chunk then waited 28 minutes on chores it could not pay (run 20261120-184924-bb3e, finding in the probe doc). Belt is four healing potions: the kit gate asked for 'healing potions 3/4' with a 3+1 belt and the chunk sat on its chores step (run 20261120-192148-b1a8). Level 26, not 30: with goals reach:30 a level-30 hero finishes its goal at once and idles, the board never starts (run 20261120-204236-684a). Necromancer variant: 4 antidotes (the first rerun parked on `not ready: 0 antidotes < 2`, run 20261123-051442), the unattended Andariel hold off (`boss.andarielHold` 0: with it on the chunk waits for a throwaway fight, run 20261123-045906), the SME build.

assert.why: the road past the Monastery Gate is open: the hero reached the Outer Cloister (run 20261120-230516-0e0d: travel from the Monastery Gate failed with no exit; fix card andariel1: the nav walks to a border d2d cannot read from afar)
no death: the board holds the fight back, a death is a RED
